senses: adv. 究竟在哪里,究竟到哪里
adv. 无论在哪里,无论到哪里

ex.en: Wherever the team performs, local audiences respond with the same enthusiasm.
ex.zh: 无论该团队在哪里演出，当地观众都以同样的热情回应。

ex.en: The app can be used wherever there is an Internet connection.
ex.zh: 只要有网络连接，这款应用在任何地方都能使用。

ex.en: Wherever he travels, he records local music and interviews ordinary people.
ex.zh: 无论他去哪里旅行，都会录制当地音乐并采访普通人。

senses: conj. 是否,会不会,不管,无论

ex.en: The board has not yet decided whether to accept the takeover offer from its foreign rival.
ex.zh: 董事会尚未决定是否接受外国竞争对手的收购要约。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

senses: pron./det. 哪一个；哪些；……的那个

ex.en: The company owns three factories, the largest of which employs over a thousand workers.
ex.zh: 该公司拥有三家工厂，其中最大的一家雇用了一千多名工人。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

senses: pron./det. 无论哪个；无论哪些
pron. 无论哪个,无论哪些
adj. 无论哪个,无论哪些

ex.en: Whichever option the government chooses, it will face strong opposition from one section of voters.
ex.zh: 无论政府选择哪种方案，都会遭到一部分选民的强烈反对。

while.usage: 又:after a while过了一会儿,不久;at the while一直,始终

ex.en: While online retail continues to expand, most consumers still prefer to buy fresh food in person.
ex.zh: 尽管网络零售持续扩张，大多数消费者仍更愿意亲自购买新鲜食品。

senses: v. 搅打,打成泡沫;偷(某物)

ex.en: The rider cracked his whip, and the horse galloped across the open field.
ex.zh: 骑手甩响鞭子，马便飞驰过开阔的原野。

ex.en: The sudden wind whipped the flags outside the parliament building.
ex.zh: 骤起的狂风猛刮议会大楼外的旗帜。

ex.en: She whipped the cream until it formed soft peaks for the dessert.
ex.zh: 她把奶油搅打到软性发泡，用来做甜点。

senses: n. 回旋,旋转,急转;眩晕,混乱

ex.en: The leaves were caught in a whirl of wind and scattered across the deserted platform.
ex.zh: 树叶被卷入一阵旋风中，散落在空荡荡的站台上。

senses: n. 旋风;旋流;一片忙乱
adj. 旋风般的;飞快的;匆匆忙忙的

ex.en: The new minister began a whirlwind tour of the region's hospitals on her first day in office.
ex.zh: 新部长上任第一天便对该地区的各医院展开了旋风般的视察。

ex.en: Sales of single malt whisky have grown sharply among younger consumers in Asia.
ex.zh: 单一麦芽威士忌在亚洲年轻消费者中的销量大幅增长。

ex.en: The bar stocks more than forty varieties of whisky from Scotland and Ireland.
ex.zh: 这家酒吧备有来自苏格兰和爱尔兰的四十多种威士忌。

ex.en: The students whispered in the back row so as not to disturb the lecture.
ex.zh: 学生们在后排低声耳语，以免打扰讲课。

ex.en: Do not wake the baby, she whispered as she entered the darkened room.
ex.zh: 她轻声说着"别吵醒宝宝"，走进昏暗的房间。

ex.en: Rumors about the merger spread through the office in whispers.
ex.zh: 关于合并的谣言以耳语的形式在办公室里传开。

ex.en: The referee's final whistle sparked celebrations among the supporters who had travelled hundreds of miles.
ex.zh: 裁判的终场哨声引发了远道而来的支持者的欢呼庆祝。

senses: adj. 白色的,白的;白种的

ex.en: Painters of the period often used white to suggest purity and spiritual calm.
ex.zh: 那个时期的画家常用白色来暗示纯洁与精神上的宁静。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

senses: pron. （询问姓名、身份或职务）谁，什么人

ex.en: Applicants who fail to submit complete documents will not be considered for the scholarship.
ex.zh: 未能提交完整材料的申请人将不予考虑授予奖学金。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

senses: pron. ……的那个人（或那些人）；……的任何人

ex.en: Whoever is responsible for the data breach will face severe penalties under the new privacy law.
ex.zh: 无论谁对数据泄露负责，都将依据新隐私法受到严厉处罚。

senses: a. 完全的；所有的；整个的
adj. 完全的,整体的,全部的

ex.en: The whole community rallied to rebuild the village hall after it was destroyed by fire.
ex.zh: 村礼堂被大火烧毁后，整个社区齐心协力将其重建。

ex.en: Union leaders said they would wholeheartedly support any fair deal on pension reform.
ex.zh: 工会领导人表示，他们将全心全意支持任何关于养老金改革的公平协议。

wholesale.usage: n.批发 adj.批发的；大规模的，大批的 adv.批发地；完全地 v.批发销售；whole（一起）+sale（卖）→一起卖→批发；索引p419

ex.en: They did their best to prevent the wholesale destruction of the cities.
ex.zh: 他们尽最大的努力防止城市遭到大规模破坏。

ex.en: The firm buys its goods wholesale and sells them at a considerable profit.
ex.zh: 这家公司批发购进商品，再以可观的利润出售。

ex.en: The report calls for the wholesale reform of the national pension system.
ex.zh: 报告呼吁对国家养老金制度进行全面改革。

ex.en: Wholesale prices rose more slowly than retail prices last quarter.
ex.zh: 上季度批发价格的上涨慢于零售价格。

ex.en: Rising transport costs are squeezing the margins of every food wholesaler in the region.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的运输成本正在挤压该地区每一家食品批发商的利润空间。

ex.en: Wholesaling remains profitable despite the rapid growth of direct-to-consumer online retail channels.
ex.zh: 尽管面向消费者的网络零售渠道迅速增长，批发业仍然有利可图。

senses: adj. 健康的,有益于健康的

ex.en: Nutritionists promote wholesome eating habits early in life to prevent obesity in later years.
ex.zh: 营养学家提倡从小养成有益健康的饮食习惯，以预防日后肥胖。

senses: ad. 完全地；全面地；整体地
adv. 完全地,全部地,一概

phrases.p: leave sth. wholly out of account

wholly.usage: 记：所有的员工都认为这个决定是完全合理的。；词根记忆：whol(e)(完全的)+ly(副词后缀)→完全地；索引p419

ex.en: The court found that the accident was not wholly the driver's fault.
ex.zh: 法庭认定事故并非完全是司机的过错。

ex.en: The report is based on evidence that is wholly inconsistent with the minister's claims.
ex.zh: 报告所依据的证据与部长的说法完全不符。

ex.en: Their success was not wholly due to luck; years of careful planning also mattered.
ex.zh: 他们的成功并非全靠运气，多年的周密规划同样重要。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

ex.en: The scholarship is awarded to students whom the selection committee judges to show exceptional promise.
ex.zh: 该奖学金授予评选委员会认为极具潜力的学生。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

senses: pron./det. 谁的；（特指）那个人的，那一个的，其

ex.en: The report examines firms whose supply chains depend heavily on imported raw materials.
ex.zh: 报告研究了那些供应链严重依赖进口原材料的企业。

ex.en: The report explains why young workers are increasingly reluctant to remain in traditional manufacturing jobs.
ex.zh: 报告解释了为什么年轻工人越来越不愿意留在传统制造业岗位上。

senses: adj. 缺德的,邪恶的,恶劣的

ex.en: The novel's villain is not wicked by nature but shaped by poverty and misfortune.
ex.zh: 小说中的反派并非天性邪恶，而是被贫穷与不幸塑造成的。

senses: ad. 尽可能远地；充分地
adj. 宽阔的,宽的,宽度为……的;大量的
adj. 范围大的;一般的;广泛的

ex.en: The survey covered a wide range of industries, from agriculture to financial services.
ex.zh: 这项调查涵盖了从农业到金融服务的广泛行业。

ex.en: The council plans to widen the main road to reduce congestion at rush hour.
ex.zh: 市政会计划拓宽主干道，以缓解高峰时段的交通拥堵。

senses: adj. 广泛的，分布广的，普遍的

phrases.p: the widespread use of motor cars

widespread.usage: 【记】wide（范围大的）+spread（传播）→传播范围大的→广泛的。近义词：common a. 普遍的；组合词:wide(广泛的)+spread(传播)→传播非常广泛的→分布广的；索引p419

ex.en: It's just that individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior.
ex.zh: 她说，只是个人行动太慢，不足以成为改变普遍行为的唯一的乃至主要的途径。

ex.en: The storm caused widespread damage to crops across the southern provinces.
ex.zh: 风暴对南部各省的农作物造成了大范围的破坏。

ex.en: There is widespread public concern about the safety of genetically modified food.
ex.zh: 公众对转基因食品的安全性普遍担忧。

ex.en: Mobile payment has won widespread acceptance among consumers of all ages.
ex.zh: 移动支付已获得各年龄段消费者的广泛接受。

ex.en: The pension scheme guarantees a monthly income for the widow and children of deceased employees.
ex.zh: 该养老金计划保障已故员工的遗孀和子女获得月度收入。

ex.en: The snow had narrowed the width of the road to a single track.
ex.zh: 大雪使路面变窄，成了单行道。

ex.en: The bridge was widened to double its original width to ease holiday traffic.
ex.zh: 这座桥被拓宽到原来宽度的两倍，以缓解节日交通压力。

ex.en: Measure the width of the doorway before you buy the new sofa.
ex.zh: 买新沙发之前先量一下门口的宽度。

ex.en: The river narrows dramatically in width as it approaches the mountains.
ex.zh: 这条河在接近山区时宽度急剧变窄。

ex.en: After his wife died, he devoted himself to charity work in the city's poorest districts.
ex.zh: 妻子去世后，他投身于该市最贫困街区的慈善工作。

senses: a. 自然生长的；荒凉的
adj. 野性的,野生的,野蛮的
adj. 荒芜的;狂热的,疯狂的
wild.usage: be wild with joy/delight欣喜若狂

ex.en: Conservationists have released twenty wolves into the wild as part of a long-term recovery programme.
ex.zh: 作为长期恢复计划的一部分，环保人士将二十只狼放归野外。

senses: n. 未开发的地区,荒无人烟的地区,荒野,荒芜的地方,杂草丛生处

ex.en: The expedition spent three weeks crossing a frozen wilderness where temperatures rarely rose above minus twenty degrees.
ex.zh: 探险队花了三周时间穿越一片冰封的荒野，那里气温很少高于零下二十度。

ex.en: The new highway includes wildlife crossings to reduce animal deaths and keep habitats connected.
ex.zh: 新高速公路设有野生动物通道，以减少动物死亡并保持栖息地相连。

ex.en: The court ruled that the company had wilfully ignored repeated safety warnings.
ex.zh: 法庭裁定，该公司蓄意无视多次安全警告。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

ex.en: Despite failing eyesight, the old professor continued writing, driven purely by will.
ex.zh: 尽管视力衰退，这位老教授仍凭着纯粹的意志力继续写作。

ex.en: The court ruled that the company had willfully ignored safety regulations for nearly a decade.
ex.zh: 法院裁定，该公司近十年来一直蓄意无视安全法规。

senses: a. 乐意的；愿意的；自愿的；积极肯干的

ex.en: Firms are more willing to invest in training when staff retention rates are high.
ex.zh: 当员工留任率较高时，企业更愿意投资于培训。

ex.en: If the alternative is redundancies, most employees will willingly accept a temporary pay cut.
ex.zh: 如果另一选择是裁员，大多数员工都会心甘情愿地接受暂时减薪。

phrases.p: show the willingness to do sth.

willingness.usage: 扩：unwillingness n. 不愿意；索引p419

ex.en: The reform's success depends largely on the public's willingness to adopt new recycling habits.
ex.zh: 改革的成功很大程度上取决于公众接受新回收习惯的意愿。

win.usage: 辨析:win取得胜利;beat击败对手;defeat战胜击败,较正式;派生:winner获胜者

ex.en: The startup managed to win a major government contract despite competition from established firms.
ex.zh: 这家初创企业尽管面临老牌企业的竞争，仍成功赢得了一份重要的政府合同。

senses: vt. 使喘不过气来；使嗳气
wind.usage: 记：wind（风）是wind（缠绕；蜿蜒）的形近词，注意区分。；派生windfall风吹落的果实;意外的收获

ex.en: A cold wind blew across the empty fields as the farmers hurried to finish the harvest.
ex.zh: 冷风吹过空旷的田野，农民们赶着完成收割。

senses: n. [C] 窗；窗户；陈列窗；窗口；空隙

ex.en: She gazed out of the window, wondering whether the delayed train would ever arrive.
ex.zh: 她望向窗外，心里想着晚点的火车到底还会不会来。

senses: adj. 受大风吹的；当风的

ex.en: The windswept island supports little agriculture beyond sheep farming.
ex.zh: 这座常年受大风吹袭的岛屿除养羊外几乎无法发展其他农业。

ex.en: Commuters complain that the new bus shelters offer little protection on windy winter mornings.
ex.zh: 通勤者抱怨说，冬季多风的早晨，新公交候车亭几乎起不到遮挡作用。

ex.en: The region is famous for the wine made from grapes grown on its sunny hillsides.
ex.zh: 该地区以阳光充足的山坡上所产葡萄酿造的葡萄酒而闻名。

ex.en: The bird spread one wing, then rose from the branch and disappeared into the sky.
ex.zh: 那只鸟展开一侧翅膀，从枝头飞起，消失在天空中。

ex.en: He gave me a quick wink to show that he had understood the plan.
ex.zh: 他朝我快速眨了眨眼，表示他已经明白了这个计划。

ex.en: Many small birds fly south before winter arrives in search of warmer weather and food.
ex.zh: 许多小鸟在冬天来临前飞往南方，寻找更温暖的天气和食物。

phrases.p: wipe the dust off the table

phrases.m: 擦去,抹去;洗刷(耻辱等),勾销(债务等)

wipe.usage: 记：我用湿抹布把桌子擦（wipe）干净了。

ex.en: She wiped the table with a damp cloth before the guests arrived.
ex.zh: 客人到来之前，她用湿抹布擦了擦桌子。

senses: v. 打电报给,用电报传送
wire.usage: 助记:用wire(金属线)把两个tire(轮胎)捆起来

ex.en: The electrician replaced the damaged wire before it could start a fire.
ex.zh: 电工更换了受损的电线，以免引发火灾。

senses: n. 智慧,明智;名言,格言
wisdom.usage: 扩：wisely ad. 明智地；助记:wis(智慧)+dom(名词后缀)→智慧；索引p419

ex.en: Traditional ecological wisdom often offers solutions that modern technology overlooks.
ex.zh: 传统生态智慧常常提供现代技术忽视的解决方案。

ex.en: It took considerable wisdom for the mediator to satisfy both sides of the dispute.
ex.zh: 调解人需要相当的智慧才能让争端双方都满意。

ex.en: The collected proverbs reflect the practical wisdom of generations of farmers.
ex.zh: 这些谚语集反映了世代农民的实用智慧。

phrases.m: 明白,察觉(某人的不轨行为)

wise.usage: 助记:wish(希望)自己变成wise(聪明的人)；索引p419

ex.en: It would be wise to book the tickets early, as the festival attracts huge crowds.
ex.zh: 提前订票是明智的，因为这个节日吸引大量人群。

ex.en: His grandmother, a wise and patient woman, taught him to judge people by their actions.
ex.zh: 他的祖母是一位明智而耐心的女性，教他通过行动来评判他人。

ex.en: Investors consider it wise to spread their money across different industries.
ex.zh: 投资者认为把钱分散到不同行业是明智的。

ex.en: She closed her eyes and made a wish before blowing out the candles.
ex.zh: 她闭上眼睛许了个愿，然后吹灭了蜡烛。

senses: a. 伤感的；徒然神往的

ex.en: She cast a wistful glance at the old family house as the train slowly pulled away from the village.
ex.zh: 火车缓缓驶离村庄时，她恋恋不舍地瞥了一眼那座老宅。

wit.usage: out of one's wits 不知所措

ex.en: The novel is admired for the wit and elegance of its dialogue.
ex.zh: 这部小说因其对话的机智与优雅而备受推崇。

witch.usage: 助记:witch(女巫)手里拿着switch(鞭子)

ex.en: In the old fairy tale, a witch turns the prince into a frog.
ex.zh: 在这个古老的童话里，女巫把王子变成了青蛙。

senses: prep. 和……在一起；有；用；与……对立；关于

ex.en: He cut the rope with a sharp knife and tied the boat to the tree.
ex.zh: 他用锋利的小刀割断绳子，把小船拴在树上。

senses: vt. 提，取（银行账户中的款）
vt. 收回（威胁、提议、请求等）
withdraw.usage: 【记】with（顺着）+draw（拉）→顺着自己的方向拉→撤回。近义词：retract vt. 撤回，收回（协议、承诺等）；记：他撤回(withdraw)了投诉，取(withdraw)出存款，然后撤退(withdraw)到乡下。；同义:abolish,cancel,retreat,quit;反义:advance;派生:

ex.en: The government has agreed to withdraw its troops.
ex.zh: 政府已经同意撤军。

ex.en: It takes several days before a check is cashed and funds are withdrawn from the issuer's account.
ex.zh: 要花费几天的时间支票才能兑现，并从发行支票者的账户里提取出来。

ex.en: He went to the nearest bank to withdraw some cash for the weekend.
ex.zh: 他去最近的银行取了些现金供周末使用。

ex.en: Under pressure from shareholders, the company withdrew its plan to close three factories.
ex.zh: 在股东压力下，该公司撤回了关闭三家工厂的计划。

senses: n. 提款，取款；撤走；收回

ex.en: The bank charges a small fee for each withdrawal made from foreign cash machines.
ex.zh: 银行对从国外自动取款机的每次取款收取少量费用。

ex.en: The country announced the withdrawal of its troops from the border region.
ex.zh: 该国宣布从边境地区撤军。

ex.en: His sudden withdrawal from the election surprised even his closest advisers.
ex.zh: 他突然退出选举，连他最亲密的顾问也感到意外。

senses: vi. 枯萎；（使）凋谢；感到羞愧难当

ex.en: Without regular rainfall, the crops began to wither and the farmers feared a poor harvest.
ex.zh: 由于缺少常规降雨，庄稼开始枯萎，农民们担心收成不佳。

phrases.m: 拒绝提供移民者的信息

withhold.usage: 助记:with(相对)+hold(保持)→保持相对→抑制；v.保留，隐瞒，扣留；索引p419

ex.en: As orders have dropped, factories have started to lay off workers, cut overtime hours and even withhold pay.
ex.zh: 订单的减少使一些工厂开始裁员，减少加班，甚至不发工资。

ex.en: The company was accused of withholding key information from its investors.
ex.zh: 该公司被指控向投资者隐瞒关键信息。

ex.en: Employers are not allowed to withhold part of a worker's wages as punishment.
ex.zh: 雇主不得扣发工人部分工资作为惩罚。

ex.en: She decided to withhold her support until she had seen the full report.
ex.zh: 她决定在看到完整报告之前暂不支持。

senses: prep. 在……里；在（某范围）之内

ex.en: Applicants must submit their forms within two weeks of the advertisement's publication.
ex.zh: 申请者必须在广告发布后两周内提交表格。

senses: prep. 没有；缺乏；无……相伴；不用

ex.en: The company could not have survived without the loyal support of its customers.
ex.zh: 没有客户的忠实支持，这家公司根本无法生存下来。

senses: vt. (withstood,withstood) 经受,承受,顶住,抵抗
withstand.usage: 记：近：resist vt. 抵制；记：with(相反)+stand(站立)→逆流而立，承受住考验。；助记:with(相对)+stand(站立)→相对站立→顶住,抵抗；with(和……在一起)+stand(站)→跟你站在一起，无论遇到什么，我们都一起"承受"；索引p419

ex.en: Moreover, even though humans have been upright for millions of years, our feet and back continue to struggle with bipedal posture and cannot easily withstand repeated strain imposed by oversize limbs.
ex.zh: 此外，尽管人类直立行走已经几百万年，但我们的脚和背部始终同两足行走的姿势相抗衡，并且难以承受过大的肢体反复施加的压力。

ex.en: The bridge is designed to withstand earthquakes of magnitude eight.
ex.zh: 这座桥的设计可以承受八级地震。

ex.en: Only a few small firms can withstand competition from the e-commerce giants.
ex.zh: 只有少数小公司能经受住电商巨头的竞争。

senses: n. 目击者,见证人;证据,证言
witness.usage: [族]witness-box n. 证人席；辨析:spectator比赛观众;passerby过路人;audience听众观众;witness目击者；n.目击者；证人；见证人 v.目击，目睹；见证，经历；wit（看见，目击）+ness。；wit（看见，目击）+ness（名词后缀）→目击者，证人。；a witness t

ex.en: Several people witnessed the attack.
ex.zh: 几个人目击了袭击事件。

ex.en: The police are appealing for witnesses to the accident to come forward.
ex.zh: 警方呼吁事故目击者站出来作证。

ex.en: The past two decades have witnessed a remarkable expansion of online shopping.
ex.zh: 过去二十年见证了网络购物的显著扩张。

ex.en: The lawyer questioned the key witness for nearly three hours in court.
ex.zh: 律师在法庭上质询关键证人近三个小时。

ex.en: The shepherd stayed awake all night to protect his sheep from the wolf.
ex.zh: 牧羊人整夜未眠，保护羊群免遭狼的袭击。

ex.en: The first woman to hold the post faced considerable doubt from her colleagues.
ex.zh: 首位担任该职位的女性曾面临同事们的诸多质疑。

senses: v. (at) 感到惊讶;感到疑惑,想要知道
wonder.usage: v.想知道，感到诧异 n.奇迹，奇观；惊奇

ex.en: Scientists wonder whether life could exist beneath the ice of distant moons.
ex.zh: 科学家想知道生命是否可能存在于遥远卫星的冰层之下。

ex.en: The Great Wall is regarded as one of the wonders of the ancient world.
ex.zh: 长城被认为是古代世界的奇迹之一。

ex.en: She wondered aloud whether the new policy would really benefit small businesses.
ex.zh: 她说出了心中的疑惑：新政策是否真能惠及小企业。

ex.en: The museum has a wonderful collection of ancient coins from different dynasties.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆藏有来自不同朝代的精彩古钱币。

ex.en: The furniture is made of solid wood harvested from managed forests.
ex.zh: 这些家具由可持续经营森林中采伐的实木制成。

ex.en: The exhibition traces how the woodcut evolved from a cheap reproduction technique into a respected art form.
ex.zh: 该展览追溯了木刻画如何从一种廉价的复制技术演变为一种受推崇的艺术形式。

wooden.usage: 助记:wood(木头)+en(形容词后缀)→木制的

ex.en: The farmer built a wooden fence to stop his sheep from wandering onto the road.
ex.zh: 农民修了一道木栅栏，防止羊群跑到马路上。

ex.en: Much of the ancient woodland has been cleared to make way for new housing developments.
ex.zh: 大片古老的林地已被清理，为新的住宅开发项目让路。

ex.en: The children were warned not to wander into the woods after dark.
ex.zh: 孩子们被告诫天黑后不要走进树林。

ex.en: This sweater is made of pure wool, so it keeps you warm in cold weather.
ex.zh: 这件毛衣是纯羊毛做的，所以寒冷天气里很保暖。

ex.en: The island's economy once depended largely on exporting woolen goods to neighbouring countries.
ex.zh: 该岛的经济曾在很大程度上依赖向邻国出口毛织品。

ex.en: The word 'sustainable' appears frequently in reports on environmental policy.
ex.zh: “可持续的”一词在环境政策报告中频繁出现。

senses: a. 话多的；冗长的；啰唆的

ex.en: The editor advised the author to cut the wordy introduction and state the argument directly.
ex.zh: 编辑建议作者删减冗长啰唆的引言，直接陈述论点。

senses: n. 产品,成品,工艺品;著作,作品;(pl.)工厂,工场
vi. 工作；产生…作用；争取

phrases.m: 解决,算出,设计出,制定出
引起,激起,逐渐上升,向上爬

work.usage: 词组out of work失业；词组还有 work on 对…起作用；从事于；at work 起作用；在工作；索引p419

ex.en: One thing that does seem to work is requiring drivers to report in person for license renewal.
ex.zh: 有一种方法似乎确实有效，那就是要求司机本人到场办理驾照更新。

ex.en: Remote work has forced managers to rethink how teams communicate and collaborate.
ex.zh: 远程办公迫使管理者重新思考团队如何沟通与协作。

ex.en: The safety campaign seems to work: accident rates have fallen for three straight years.
ex.zh: 安全宣传似乎起了作用：事故率已连续三年下降。

ex.en: Her early novels are now regarded as serious works of literature.
ex.zh: 她的早期小说现在被视为严肃的文学作品。

senses: n. (常构成复合词)工作者,人员
n. (通常置于形容词后)干活……的人

ex.en: Average wages have barely risen, although each worker is producing far more than before.
ex.zh: 尽管每个工人的产出比以前多得多，平均工资却几乎没有上涨。

ex.en: The factory retrained every worker affected by the introduction of robots.
ex.zh: 工厂对因引入机器人而受影响的每个工人都进行了再培训。

ex.en: Health inspectors found that night workers were not receiving legally required breaks.
ex.zh: 卫生检查人员发现夜班工人没有获得法律规定的休息时间。

senses: n. 劳动力,劳动大军,劳动人口
workforce.usage: n.劳动力，劳动人口；全体员 工 cite 一个评论家的话，humor 是马克·吐温的lifestyle。在他entire 的一生中，他frequently obtain 来自 native 和国外release 文章的邀请。他用一己之力s；索引p419

ex.en: An aging workforce is pushing many companies to invest in automation.
ex.zh: 劳动力老龄化正促使许多公司投资自动化。

ex.en: The tech firm recruits globally to build a workforce with diverse skills and backgrounds.
ex.zh: 这家科技公司全球招聘，以建立一支技能和背景多元的员工队伍。

ex.en: Better childcare provision would help more women remain in the workforce.
ex.zh: 更好的托育服务将帮助更多女性留在劳动人口中。

senses: n. (某人或组织的)工作量,工作负担

ex.en: Doctors complained that the growing workload was beginning to affect the quality of patient care.
ex.zh: 医生们抱怨说，不断加重的工作负担开始影响医疗护理的质量。

ex.en: Although it can be a workout on its own, if your goal is to get back to Zumba classes, tennis, cycling, or any other activity, walking is also a great first step.
ex.zh: 尽管步行本身就是一种锻炼，但如果你的目标是重回尊巴课堂，重新进行打网球、骑自行车或任何其他活动，步行也是很好的第一步。

ex.en: A twenty-minute workout before breakfast has become part of her daily routine.
ex.zh: 早餐前锻炼二十分钟已成为她日常生活的一部分。

ex.en: Experts recommend a short workout at your desk to relieve muscle tension during long office hours.
ex.zh: 专家建议在办公桌前进行短时锻炼，以缓解长时间办公造成的肌肉紧张。

ex.en: He tracks every workout with a fitness app on his phone.
ex.zh: 他用手机上的健身应用记录每一次锻炼。

ex.en: Employers must provide a safe workplace, whatever the cost of the necessary equipment.
ex.zh: 无论必要设备成本如何，雇主都必须提供安全的工作场所。

ex.en: The survey found that flexible hours are now the most valued workplace benefit.
ex.zh: 调查发现，弹性工作时间已成为最受人重视的职场福利。

ex.en: New regulations aim to prevent discrimination against older candidates in the workplace.
ex.zh: 新法规旨在防止工作场所对年长求职者的歧视。

senses: n. 专题讨论会,讲习班

ex.en: The university will hold a free workshop on academic writing for first-year students.
ex.zh: 该校将为大一学生举办一场免费的学术写作讲习班。

ex.en: Each employee is provided with an adjustable chair and a computer workstation.
ex.zh: 每位员工都配备了一把可调节的椅子和一个电脑工作站。

ex.en: She cleared the worktable and laid out the tools needed for the repair.
ex.zh: 她清理好工作台，摆出修理所需的工具。

senses: n. （the world）[sing.] 世界；天下；世俗；世事

ex.en: The Internet has changed the way people in every part of the world communicate and work.
ex.zh: 互联网改变了世界各地人们交流与工作的方式。

ex.en: The monk seemed indifferent to worldly success, caring little for money or fame.
ex.zh: 这位僧侣似乎对世俗的成功漠不关心，对金钱和名望毫不在意。

ex.en: Travel and reading can gradually reshape a person's worldview.
ex.zh: 旅行和阅读能逐渐重塑一个人的世界观。

senses: a./ad. 遍及全世界（的）；在全世界
adj. 全世界的,世界范围的
worldwide.usage: 助记:world(世界)+wide(宽的)→世界范围的；adj.世界范围的，全世界的 adv.在全世界，在世界各地

ex.en: The company ships its products worldwide through regional distribution centers.
ex.zh: 该公司通过区域配送中心向全世界发货。

ex.en: Worldwide demand for electric vehicles has grown faster than manufacturers predicted.
ex.zh: 全球对电动汽车的需求增长超过了制造商的预期。

ex.en: The charity runs literacy programs worldwide, from rural Africa to urban South America.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构在世界各地开展扫盲项目，从非洲农村到南美城市。

ex.en: In his later years the professor abandoned worldly ambitions and devoted himself entirely to teaching.
ex.zh: 晚年时，这位教授抛开了世俗的抱负，全身心投入教学。

senses: n. 虫,蠕虫;可怜虫,小人物
worm.usage: 发音类似“乌木”→乌木受潮了，里面长了很多虫子→蠕虫。

ex.en: Worms burrow down into the soil.
ex.zh: 蠕虫往土里钻。

ex.en: Birds search the wet grass for worms after every summer rain.
ex.zh: 每场夏雨过后，鸟儿在湿润的草地上觅食蠕虫。

ex.en: Gardeners welcome worms because their tunnels loosen the soil and improve drainage.
ex.zh: 园丁欢迎蚯蚓，因为它们挖的通道能疏松土壤、改善排水。

ex.en: Early computer worms spread rapidly by copying themselves across the network.
ex.zh: 早期计算机蠕虫通过网络自我复制而迅速传播。

ex.en: Parents are increasingly worried about the amount of time their children spend online.
ex.zh: 父母们越来越担心孩子上网所花的时间。

ex.en: The continued rise in youth unemployment is worrisome for many policymakers.
ex.zh: 青年失业率的持续上升令许多政策制定者感到担忧。

senses: n. 忧虑；令人忧虑的事
n. 忧虑；令人担忧的事
worry.usage: 近 be concerned about；词组show signs of worry显出焦虑的样子

ex.en: Parents often worry that their children spend too much time on mobile phones.
ex.zh: 父母常常担心孩子花太多时间玩手机。

ex.en: The weather grew worse as the climbers approached the summit of the mountain.
ex.zh: 登山者接近山顶时，天气变得愈发恶劣。

worsen.usage: aggravate 的近义词；deteriorate 的近义词；索引p419

ex.en: Over the past decade, the focus has been on climate change—how the warming of the Earth from greenhouse gases is leading to conditions that worsen fires.
ex.zh: 在过去的十年中，(讨论的)焦点一直是气候变化——温室气体所导致的全球变暖是如何为野火更加多发创造条件的。

senses: n. 礼拜,敬神,敬神活动
v. 崇拜,敬奉;做礼拜,拜神
worship.usage: worth(价值)+ship→认为有价值→崇拜；worship 多指对神过分盲目地崇拜;admire 指钦佩、羡慕;regard 指重视、尊重;adore 指极度喜爱崇拜；v.敬奉；崇拜；普通人看见军舰（warship），会张大嘴巴，露出崇拜（worship）的眼神。；索引p419

ex.en: Blindly worshipping those physically attractive individuals exerts bad influence on the study of youngsters.
ex.zh: 盲目崇拜那些颜值高的人给年轻人的学习带来了不好的影响。

ex.en: The article criticizes the younger generation's worship of celebrities and wealth.
ex.zh: 文章批评了年轻一代对名人和财富的崇拜。

ex.en: Thousands of pilgrims gathered at the ancient temple to worship.
ex.zh: 成千上万的朝圣者聚集在这座古庙进行礼拜。

ex.en: He tends to worship his mentor and rarely questions her judgement.
ex.zh: 他倾向于崇拜自己的导师，很少质疑她的判断。

senses: n. [C] 做礼拜的人；拜神者；敬神者
n. 崇拜上帝(或神)的人；做礼拜的人

ex.en: Hundreds of worshippers gathered in the cathedral for the Christmas service.
ex.zh: 数百名礼拜者聚集在大教堂参加圣诞节礼拜。

ex.en: The ancient temple still draws worshippers from villages many miles away.
ex.zh: 这座古庙仍然吸引着许多英里外村庄的拜神者。

ex.en: Volunteers guide worshippers to their seats before the morning service begins.
ex.zh: 志愿者在晨间礼拜开始前引导礼拜者入座。

ex.en: The worst flood in decades destroyed crops and houses across the region.
ex.zh: 几十年来最严重的洪灾摧毁了该地区的庄稼和房屋。

senses: a. 有……价值；（指行动）值得

phrases.p: be worth sb.'s while (to do/doing sth.)

worth.usage: worth 后接v.+ing,名词义为价值;worthy 后接不定式或 of;worthwhile 指值得做的;worth one's while 指值得某人费事；索引p419

ex.en: Good governance rests on an understanding of the inherent worth of each individual.
ex.zh: 良好的治理在于理解每个人内在的价值。

ex.en: This idea is well worth considering.
ex.zh: 这个想法很值得考虑。

ex.en: These results suggest that imagining the outcome of following through on one's curiosity ahead of time can help determine whether it is worth the endeavor.
ex.zh: 这些(研究)成果表明，事先设想遵循自己好奇心的结果将有助于人们决定是否值得一试。

ex.en: Critics dismissed the theory as worthless, but later experiments proved it roughly correct.
ex.zh: 批评者认为该理论毫无价值，但后来的实验证明它大体正确。

senses: adj. 重要的；令人愉快的；有趣的；值得花时间（或花钱、努力等）的
worthwhile.usage: 【记】worth（值得）+while（一段时间）→值得花一段时间的→有价值的；adj.重要的，有益的，值得做 的；索引p419

ex.en: Volunteering at the local hospital proved a worthwhile experience for the students.
ex.zh: 在当地医院做志愿者对学生来说是一段有意义的经历。

ex.en: It is worthwhile to compare prices online before making a large purchase.
ex.zh: 在进行大额消费之前先上网比价是值得的。

ex.en: The committee agreed that further research into the disease was worthwhile.
ex.zh: 委员会一致认为对该疾病作进一步研究是值得的。

senses: adj. 可尊敬的,有价值的,大有作为的
adj. 值得的；值得尊敬的；值得注意的
worthy.usage: adj.值得尊敬的；值得的 n.知名人士，要人；拓展：worth adj.有……价值；值……钱；值得 n.价值，意义

ex.en: The money we raise will be going to a very worthy cause.
ex.zh: 我们筹集的钱款将用于非常崇高的事业。

ex.en: The problem is worthy of careful study before any decision is made.
ex.zh: 这个问题值得在作出任何决定之前仔细研究。

ex.en: She is a worthy winner of the literature prize.
ex.zh: 她是当之无愧的文学奖得主。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

ex.en: He promised that he would return the borrowed notes before the examination.
ex.zh: 他答应会在考试前归还借来的笔记。

ex.en: The nurse cleaned the wound carefully to prevent any infection.
ex.zh: 护士仔细清洗了伤口以防感染。

senses: v. 包，裹（礼物等）；用……包裹（或包扎、覆盖等）

phrases.m: 被包藏于……中,埋头于,被牵涉在……中

wrap.usage: 助记:妈妈rap(责备)我把她的wrap(围巾)掉进了trap(陷阱)里;同义cover,envelop,bind,pack;反义unwrap v.打开,解开；发音类似"外婆"→外婆总是围着围巾；索引p419

ex.en: He spent the evening wrapping up the Christmas presents.
ex.zh: 他花了一个晚上的时间把圣诞礼物都包了起来。

ex.en: She wrapped the scarf around her neck and stepped into the snow.
ex.zh: 她把围巾裹在脖子上，走进了雪中。

ex.en: The gift was wrapped in plain brown paper.
ex.zh: 礼物用素色牛皮纸包着。

senses: v. 造成,引起(灾祸等);实施

ex.en: The storm wreaked havoc on the coastal towns, tearing roofs off houses.
ex.zh: 风暴给沿海城镇造成严重破坏，掀走了许多房屋的屋顶。

ex.en: A wreath of poppies was laid at the memorial to honour the fallen soldiers.
ex.zh: 人们向纪念碑敬献了罂粟花环，以缅怀阵亡将士。

senses: n. 失事船(或飞机);残骸;破坏,毁坏
vt. (船等)失事,遇难;破坏,毁坏
n. 失事；沉船；受到严重损伤的人

ex.en: Divers explored the wreck of a merchant ship that sank two centuries ago.
ex.zh: 潜水员探索了一艘两百年前沉没的商船残骸。

ex.en: The storm wrecked years of effort to restore the coastal wetlands.
ex.zh: 风暴毁坏了修复沿海湿地多年的努力。

ex.en: Investigators blamed poor maintenance for the train wreck that injured dozens of passengers.
ex.zh: 调查人员将造成数十名乘客受伤的火车失事归咎于维护不善。

ex.en: Investigators combed through the wreckage of the crashed aircraft for clues to the cause of the accident.
ex.zh: 调查人员仔细搜寻坠毁飞机的残骸，寻找事故原因的线索。

ex.en: He grabbed a wrench from the toolbox and tightened the loose bolts.
ex.zh: 他从工具箱里抓起一把扳手，拧紧了松动的螺栓。

ex.en: Wrestling was among the earliest sports to be included in the ancient Olympic Games.
ex.zh: 摔跤是最早被列入古代奥运会的运动项目之一。

ex.en: She smiled, and a deep wrinkle appeared at the corner of her eye.
ex.zh: 她一笑，眼角便现出一道深深的皱纹。

ex.en: He broke his wrist when he fell off his bicycle last weekend.
ex.zh: 上周末他骑车摔倒，摔断了手腕。

senses: vt.&vi. 书写；写字；写作；作曲；写信

ex.en: Employees are required to write a short summary at the end of each project.
ex.zh: 员工须在每个项目结束时撰写一份简短总结。

ex.en: The writer spent three years collecting material for her first novel.
ex.zh: 这位作家花了三年时间为她的第一部小说收集素材。

writing.usage: 记：作家通过写作(writing)来创作作品(writings)。

ex.en: Clear writing is essential in academic work, where complex ideas must be conveyed precisely.
ex.zh: 清晰的书面表达在学术工作中至关重要，因为复杂的思想必须得到准确传达。

senses: a. 错误的；不对的；出错；不正常

ex.en: The witness realised that his first answer was wrong and corrected it immediately.
ex.zh: 证人意识到自己最初的回答是错的，立即做了更正。

ex.en: The committee was set up to investigate allegations of financial wrongdoing within the company.
ex.zh: 该委员会的成立是为了调查有关公司内部财务违法行为的指控。

senses: v. 用X光线检查、治疗或拍摄

ex.en: The doctor ordered an X-ray to see whether the bone was broken.
ex.zh: 医生要求拍X光片，查看骨头是否断裂。

senses: 表状态、行为、物，名词词性

ex.en: Wearing a helmet greatly reduces the risk of head injury while cycling.
ex.zh: 骑自行车时戴头盔能大大降低头部受伤的风险。

ex.en: The wealthy businessman sailed his yacht across the Mediterranean every summer.
ex.zh: 这位富商每年夏天驾驶游艇横渡地中海。

ex.en: The children played in the yard while their parents prepared lunch indoors.
ex.zh: 孩子们在院子里玩耍，父母则在屋里准备午饭。

ex.en: Several students began to yawn during the second hour of the lecture.
ex.zh: 讲座进行到第二个小时，几名学生开始打起呵欠。

ex.en: The number of visitors to the museum doubled within a single year.
ex.zh: 短短一年之内，博物馆的参观人数翻了一番。

senses: adj. 每年的,一年一度的
yearly.usage: year(年)+ly(形容词兼副词后缀)→每年的

ex.en: The society holds its yearly meeting in October to elect new officers.
ex.zh: 该协会每年十月举行年会，选举新的负责人。

ex.en: His poems express a deep yearning for the countryside of his childhood.
ex.zh: 他的诗表达了对童年乡村生活的深深向往。

ex.en: The coach had to yell to make himself heard above the cheering crowd.
ex.zh: 教练不得不大声喊叫，才能让自己的声音盖过欢呼的人群。

ex.en: The leaves turn yellow before they fall from the trees in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天，树叶在从树上落下之前会变黄。

ex.en: Asked whether the data supported the theory, the researcher answered yes.
ex.zh: 当被问到数据是否支持该理论时，研究者给出了肯定回答。

ex.en: The committee announced its final decision yesterday after a long debate.
ex.zh: 经过长时间辩论，委员会昨天宣布了最终决定。

phrases.m: 到目前为止,到那时为止

ex.en: The results of the experiment have not yet been published in any journal.
ex.zh: 实验结果尚未在任何期刊上发表。

yield.usage: 他的土地field产量yield不错；串词记忆：那片田地(field)盛产(yield)玉米；索引p419

ex.en: Typically, they survey and sample (make test excavations on) large areas of terrain to determine where excavation will yield useful information.
ex.zh: 通常情况下,他们对大面积地形进行勘察并取样(测试挖掘)来确定在何处挖掘能得到有用信息。

ex.en: Google farms us for the data that our digital lives yield.
ex.zh: 谷歌"养殖"我们是为了获取我们数字生活中产生的数据。

ex.en: If she hopes her new-found fortune will yield lasting feelings of fulfilment, she could do worse than read Happy Money by Elizabeth Dunn and Michael Norton.
ex.zh: 如果她希望这笔新得到的财产能带来持久的满足感，那她最好还是读一下伊丽莎白·杜恩和迈克尔·诺顿合著的《幸福金钱》。

ex.en: If you compare the two sets of data, the difference becomes obvious.
ex.zh: 如果对比这两组数据，差异便一目了然。

senses: a. 幼小的；年轻的；青少年的

ex.en: The program offers free training to young people who want careers in technology.
ex.zh: 该项目为想从事技术行业的年轻人提供免费培训。

youngster.usage: 记：年轻人就应该有年轻人的样子。

ex.en: The sports club offers free swimming lessons to youngsters during the summer holidays.
ex.zh: 该体育俱乐部在暑假期间为孩子们提供免费游泳课。

senses: det. 你的；您的；你们的；（泛指）大家的，人们的

ex.en: Please check your answers carefully before you hand in the test paper.
ex.zh: 交卷之前请仔细检查你的答案。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

ex.en: Is this umbrella yours? Someone left it on the train this morning.
ex.zh: 这把伞是你的吗？今天早上有人把它落在火车上了。

senses: pron. 你自己；您自己；你们自己

ex.en: You should give yourself enough time to revise before the examination.
ex.zh: 你应当在考试前给自己留出足够的复习时间。

ex.en: Please help yourselves to the refreshments provided in the lobby.
ex.zh: 请自取大堂提供的茶点。

books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

senses: pron. 你自己；您自己；你们自己

ex.en: Introduce yourselves briefly before the discussion begins.
ex.zh: 讨论开始前请先简单介绍一下你们自己。

senses: n. [U] 青年时期（尤指成年以前）
youth.usage: 记：在这些年轻人身上我们能看到青春的活力。

ex.en: The government has launched a new program to tackle youth unemployment in rural areas.
ex.zh: 政府已启动一项新计划，以解决农村地区的青年失业问题。

zeal.usage: 派生zealous adj. 热心的,热情的,积极的

ex.en: She pursued her research with such zeal that she often worked late into the night.
ex.zh: 她以极大的热忱投入研究，常常工作到深夜。

ex.en: Each zebra's stripe pattern is unique, much like a human fingerprint.
ex.zh: 每只斑马的条纹图案都是独一无二的，就像人类的指纹一样。

senses: v. 将注意力集中于某人(某事物)上

ex.en: The team's hopes of reaching the final fell to almost zero after the defeat.
ex.zh: 那场失利之后，球队进入决赛的希望几乎降为零。

senses: adj. 之字形的,锯齿形的
v. 呈之字形移动,曲折行进

ex.en: The narrow path runs in a zigzag up the steep hillside.
ex.zh: 狭窄的小路呈之字形盘上陡峭的山坡。

senses: n. 拉链;尖啸声,嘘;精神,精力,活力
vt. 拉开或拉上;突进,直冲

ex.en: He pulled up the zip of his jacket against the cold sea wind.
ex.zh: 他拉上夹克的拉链，抵挡海边寒冷的风。

ex.en: The city has designated a special economic zone to attract foreign investment.
ex.zh: 该市划定了一个经济特区以吸引外国投资。

ex.en: Much of the coastal zone was closed after the oil spill contaminated the beaches.
ex.zh: 石油泄漏污染海滩后，大部分沿海地带被关闭。

ex.en: The earthquake zone remains closed to outsiders while rescue teams search for survivors.
ex.zh: 在救援队搜寻幸存者期间，地震区域仍不对外人开放。

ex.en: The zoo hopes to breed rare pandas and eventually return them to the wild.
ex.zh: 动物园希望繁殖珍稀大熊猫，并最终将它们放归野外。

senses: vi. (电视摄像机等)镜头快速移动
v. (价格等)急剧上涨,突然扩大

ex.en: House prices have zoomed in recent years, leaving many young families unable to buy a home.
ex.zh: 近年来房价飞涨，许多年轻家庭因此买不起房。
